claims.statement: Chalmers argues for fundamental experience and supplementary psychophysical principles, describing his proposal as naturalistic dualism.
alternative_explanations: This documents an argued position, not the truth of its premises; project PH variants contest the inference from explanatory gap to ontology.

arguments.name: Physicalism operational comparison
arguments.position: M-T03-PH; project stipulation, not philosopher attribution
premises: A complete physical realization account is possible.
bridge_principles: Conceptual differences need not establish ontological differences.
arguments.conclusion: Physical constitution is a viable comparator.
arguments.strongest_reply: Identity or grounding need not be conceptually transparent.
unresolved_issues: Premises are unassessed. Detailed residual costs, criteria and conditional discriminators: report.md, Motivations, challenges, replies and discriminators.

arguments.name: Psychophysical laws operational comparison
arguments.position: M-T03-PL; project stipulation, not philosopher attribution
premises: Additional experiential resources may be required.
bridge_principles: General laws can explain instances without explaining their own existence.
arguments.conclusion: A constrained law model is a viable comparator.
arguments.strongest_objection: Mappings may leave their central dependence brute.
arguments.strongest_reply: Apply the same explanatory stopping rules across models.
unresolved_issues: Premises are unassessed. Detailed residual costs, criteria and conditional discriminators: report.md, Motivations, challenges, replies and discriminators.

arguments.name: Panpsychism operational comparison
arguments.position: M-T03-PA; project stipulation, not philosopher attribution
premises: Experiential constituents may support an account of complex subjects.
bridge_principles: An explicit constitutive relation can ground unified subjecthood.
arguments.strongest_objection: Many subjects do not evidently constitute one subject.
arguments.strongest_reply: Specify and constrain a subject-constitution relation.
unresolved_issues: Premises are unassessed. Detailed residual costs, criteria and conditional discriminators: report.md, Motivations, challenges, replies and discriminators.

arguments.name: Dualism operational comparison
arguments.position: M-T03-DU; project stipulation, not philosopher attribution
premises: Subjectivity may require distinct irreducible bearers.
bridge_principles: Distinct subjects can have coherent, constrained relations to bodies.
arguments.conclusion: An explicit dualist model warrants comparison.
arguments.strongest_objection: Interaction may conflict with a complete physical causal account.
arguments.strongest_reply: Assess causal completeness and explicit interaction laws separately.
unresolved_issues: Premises are unassessed. Detailed residual costs, criteria and conditional discriminators: report.md, Motivations, challenges, replies and discriminators.

arguments.name: Idealism operational comparison
arguments.position: M-T03-ID; project stipulation, not philosopher attribution
premises: A conscious basis could ground experience and a public ordered world.
bridge_principles: A grounding model can earn support through explanatory success.
arguments.strongest_objection: Experiential knowledge does not prove mental ontology.
arguments.strongest_reply: Offer an overall explanatory argument and perspective-individuation model.
unresolved_issues: Premises are unassessed. Detailed residual costs, criteria and conditional discriminators: report.md, Motivations, challenges, replies and discriminators.

arguments.name: Theism operational comparison
arguments.position: M-T03-TH; project stipulation, not philosopher attribution
premises: Intentional agency may provide that explanation.
bridge_principles: Independent arguments are required for agency, good ends and moral authority.
arguments.conclusion: A specified intentional creator warrants comparison.
arguments.strongest_objection: Explanation alone does not identify mind, goodness or authority.
arguments.strongest_reply: Supply distinct agency and normative arguments; test specified ends against suffering and hiddenness.
